result.title: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Sentiment Prediction Under Local Modality Missingness
result.summary: Multimodal sentiment models are usually evaluated on complete utterances, yet streams often lose a contiguous span of text, audio, or video. We study local missingness on aligned CMU-MOSEI features. Our reliability-aware network (RM-Net) keeps the original temporal positions, represents unobserved positions with a learned token, outputs bounded per-modality intensity contributions gated by observation quality, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. We fuse five RM-Net seeds with a LoRA-adapted BERT text expert, using a fusion weight that depends only on the visible fraction of content tokens. Architecture, checkpoint, and fusion choices were made on the validation split. On the held-out split, the fused model reaches a macro-F1 of 0.655 on clean inputs and 0.634 under 40\% mixed missingness; its two-view average exceeds the auxiliary-head baseline by 0.024 (95\% video-cluster bootstrap interval [0.003, 0.045]). Because this split was inspected during development, these numbers are not a blind test. For explanations, exact Shapley attributions over the eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion show that top-ranked positions reduce the predicted-class probability faster than random positions (AUC gap 0.113 on validation). We also describe an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips; its outputs do not feed the predictive models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究对齐 CMU-MOSEI 特征上连续片段缺失时的多模态情感预测，提出 RM-Net：保留原始时序位置、用可学习 token 表示未观测位置、输出受观测质量门控的有界模态强度贡献，并以双视角片段掩码训练，另用 Shapley 归因与位置级遮挡做解释。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「缺失位置用可学习 token + 按观测质量门控模态贡献」的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据缺失、证据筛选与 latent 状态贡献分配提供方法线索；位置级遮挡与 Shapley 归因可供核查证据因果作用与评价方式，虽属情感分类任务，仍需较多迁移核查。
